content:
**Brief Answer** Colonoscopy coverage depends on whether it is performed as a **preventive screening** or as a **diagnostic/outpatient procedure**. Preventive screening colonoscopy is covered at **No Charge** when performed by an HMO provider; diagnostic colonoscopy generally falls under outpatient surgery/professional and facility benefits, with **35% coinsurance** and some facility services subject to the medical deductible. --- **Detailed Explanation** **HMO PCP/ Medical Group coordination disclaimer:** Because this is a HMO plan, the member must receive services from either an in-network provider or a provider associated with their medical group to be eligible for benefits. A referral from the member's primary care physician (PCP) is usually required when the member wants to see a specialist or other provider. Colonoscopy can be done as a preventive screening to detect potential issues before symptoms arise. These are referred as a screening and are covered under the Annual Health Exam benefits. They can also be done when there are specific symptoms or risk factors that warrant further investigation. These are known as a diagnostic procedures.

A. Preventive Screening Colonoscopy — Annual Health Exam

In-Network Provider

For in-network providers, preventive screening services under Annual Health Exams are covered at **No Charge** [1]. The plan will reimburse the provider 100% of the allowed amount for Annual Health Exams.

Out-of-Network Provider

For out-of-network providers, the member is responsible for 100% of the provider's billed amount, as the plan only covers in-network providers. ---

B. Diagnostic Colonoscopy — Outpatient Professional Services

This would generally include the physician/surgeon professional component when the colonoscopy is performed in an outpatient setting.

In-Network Provider

For in-network providers, Physician or surgeon services in an outpatient facility are covered at **35% coinsurance** [2]. However, Physician or surgeon services in an outpatient facility is not subject to the deductible. The coinsurance is **35%** of the allowed amount, and the plan will reimburse the remaining **65%** of the allowed amount for Physician or surgeon services in an outpatient facility services. The service applies to the plan's out-of-pocket maximum amount of **$8,750 individual out-of-pocket maximum**, not to exceed **$17,500 family out-of-pocket maximum** per family. When the plan's out-of-pocket maximum amount is satisfied, the health plan will reimburse 100% of the allowed amount.

Out-of-Network Provider

For out-of-network providers, the member is responsible for 100% of the provider's billed amount, as the plan only covers in-network providers. ---

C. Diagnostic Colonoscopy — Outpatient Hospital Facility Surgery

In-Network Provider

For in-network providers, Outpatient Hospital Facility Services for Surgery are covered at **35% coinsurance** [3]. The plan has a **$2,500 deductible per person**, not to exceed **$5,000 per family**. Outpatient Hospital Facility Services for Surgery is subject to this deductible. Once the deductible is met, The coinsurance is **35%** of the allowed amount, and the plan will reimburse the remaining **65%** of the allowed amount for Outpatient Hospital Facility Services for Surgery services. The service applies to the plan's out-of-pocket maximum amount of **$8,750 individual out-of-pocket maximum**, not to exceed **$17,500 family out-of-pocket maximum** per family. When the plan's out-of-pocket maximum amount is satisfied, the health plan will reimburse 100% of the allowed amount.

Out-of-Network Provider

For out-of-network providers, the member is responsible for 100% of the provider's billed amount, as the plan only covers in-network providers. ---

D. Diagnostic Colonoscopy — Ambulatory Surgery Center

In-Network Provider

For in-network providers, Ambulatory Surgery Center facility services are covered at **35% coinsurance** [4]. The plan has a **$2,500 deductible per person**, not to exceed **$5,000 per family**. Ambulatory Surgery Center facility services is subject to this deductible. Once the deductible is met, The coinsurance is **35%** of the allowed amount, and the plan will reimburse the remaining **65%** of the allowed amount for Ambulatory Surgery Center facility services services. The service applies to the plan's out-of-pocket maximum amount of **$8,750 individual out-of-pocket maximum**, not to exceed **$17,500 family out-of-pocket maximum** per family. When the plan's out-of-pocket maximum amount is satisfied, the health plan will reimburse 100% of the allowed amount.

Out-of-Network Provider

For out-of-network providers, the member is responsible for 100% of the provider's billed amount, as the plan only covers in-network providers. --- **Surgery Disclaimer:** In addition to the surgeon's and facility bill, the member can expect related fees for professional services like anesthesia or any related to diagnostic testing (e.g., radiological, pathology, or laboratory). A surgical package includes the surgical procedure, pre-operative care medical visits on the same day of surgery and normal uncomplicated follow-up care. **Access+ referral information:** The patient does not need a referral for: Emergency Services; Urgent Services; Access+ Specialist visits; OB/GYN services by an obstetrician, gynecologist, or family practice Physician within the patient's Medical Group; and Office visits with the patient's primary care physician (PCP). The Access+ specialist visit includes: (1) An examination or consultation without referral from personal physician; (2) Conventional X-rays; (3) Laboratory Services; (4) Diagnostic or treatment procedures which a plan specialist would regularly provide under a referral. --- **Sources & Citations** | Ref | Benefit/Service | Cost Share | Source | |-----|-----------------|------------|--------| | [1] | Annual Health Exams / preventive screening | No Charge | eocCategories > Preventive Health Services > Annual Health Exams > Annual Health Exams > providerCostShares | | [2] | Physician or surgeon services in an outpatient facility | 35% Coinsurance; not subject to deductible; applies to OOPM | eocCategories > Physician and other Professional Services > In-hospital services > Physician or surgeon services in an outpatient facility > providerCostShares | | [3] | Outpatient Hospital Facility Services for Surgery | 35% Coinsurance; subject to deductible; applies to OOPM | eocCategories > Hospital Services > Outpatient > Surgeries > providerCostShares | | [4] | Ambulatory Surgery Center facility services | 35% Coinsurance; subject to deductible; applies to OOPM | eocCategories > Hospital Services > Ambulatory Surgery Centers > Surgery > providerCostShares | | [5] | Medical deductible and out-of-pocket maximum | $2,500 individual / $5,000 family deductible; $8,750 individual / $17,500 family OOPM | planCostShares > Medical Deductible; planCostShares > OOP Maximum | | [6] | Screening vs diagnostic colonoscopy mapping and diagnostic services | Preventive screening and diagnostic testing language | eocCategories > Diagnostic X-ray, imaging, pathology, laboratory, and other testing services > content; eocCategories > Preventive Health Services > content | | [7] | HMO Access+ referral information | Referral exceptions and Access+ specialist visit details | eocSections > Prior Authorization > General |
